title: Maze Solver
description: solve_maze(maze, wall, start, end) returns a path of points, or nullopt if unreachable.
interface: solve_maze(maze: string[], wall: string, start: Point, end: Point) -> Point[]
example: 2x2 open maze, start (0,0) end (1,1) -> path of 4 points

cpp.fn: vector<Point> solve_maze(const vector<string>& maze, const string& wall, Point start, Point end)
structs: struct Point { int x, y; bool operator==(const Point& o) const { return x == o.x && y == o.y; } };
cpp.hint: // return the point path from start to end, or nullopt
